items.title: Louis Hayes interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: He had been appearing with Dinah Washington... Joe's facilities were marvelous, but that was a little different accompanying a vocalist naturally.

ctx.x: Yeah. What was he like to work with?

Joe was wonderful. Joe, actually, Joe when he first joined the band Joe was kind of nervous, because he hadn’t been in that situation before. He had been appearing with Dinah Washington, which was — Joe’s facilities were marvelous, but that was a little different accompanying a vocalist naturally. But this was, with Cannonball, it was every person for himself. You had to be ready, creative, you know. Everybody was on their own. So Sam and myself, we used to have these meetings. Because we were so close, you know,…
